name: Enduring Warding (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Warding arcana

Benefit: When the magus expends a point from his arcane pool to grant enhancement bonuses or properties to his armor, the bonuses and properties last for 1 minute/level.

Ultimate Options: New Magus Arcana Ultimate Options: New Magus Arcana. Copyright 2011, Super Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
